title: Working from Home
sentences: Since the pandemic, millions of people have been working from home at least part of the week.
Pandemiyadan beri millionlab odamlar haftaning hech bo'lmaganda bir qismida uydan ishlamoqda.
The most obvious advantage is flexibility: you can organise your day around your life, not the other way round.
Eng aniq afzalligi — moslashuvchanlik: kuningizni hayotingizga moslab tuzasiz, aksincha emas.
You also save the time and money you would normally spend on your commute.
Odatda ishga qatnashga ketadigan vaqt va pulni ham tejaysiz.
Many employees say they are more productive at home because there are fewer meetings.
Ko'p xodimlar uyda unumliroq ekanini aytishadi, chunki yig'ilishlar kamroq.
On the other hand, home is full of distractions, from housework to social media.
Boshqa tomondan, uy chalg'ituvchi narsalarga to'la: uy ishlaridan ijtimoiy tarmoqlargacha.
Some people also feel isolated because they miss chatting with colleagues.
Ba'zilar esa hamkasblari bilan suhbatni sog'inib, o'zini yolg'iz his qiladi.
The biggest challenge, however, is setting clear boundaries between work and rest.
Biroq eng katta qiyinchilik ish va dam olish o'rtasida aniq chegara qo'yishdir.
Experts recommend having a separate workspace and fixed working hours.
Mutaxassislar alohida ish joyi va qat'iy ish vaqtiga ega bo'lishni tavsiya qilishadi.
In the end, remote work suits some personalities much better than others.
Oxir-oqibat, masofaviy ish ba'zi fe'l-atvorlarga boshqalarga qaraganda ancha mos keladi.

title: Is Social Media Making Us Lonely?
sentences: Social media was designed to help us connect with friends and family.
Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bizga do'stlar va oila bilan bog'lanishga yordam berish uchun yaratilgan.
Ironically, a growing number of studies suggest that heavy users often feel lonelier.
Ajablanarlisi, tobora ko'proq tadqiqotlar faol foydalanuvchilar ko'pincha o'zini yolg'izroq his qilishini ko'rsatmoqda.
One reason is that we constantly compare our ordinary lives with other people's best moments.
Sabablardan biri — biz oddiy hayotimizni doimo boshqalarning eng yaxshi lahzalari bilan solishtiramiz.
This comparison can lead to anxiety and low self-esteem, especially among teenagers.
Bu solishtirish, ayniqsa o'smirlarda, xavotir va o'zini past baholashga olib kelishi mumkin.
Another consequence is that online chats sometimes replace genuine conversations.
Yana bir oqibati — onlayn yozishmalar ba'zan haqiqiy suhbatlar o'rnini egallaydi.
However, social media itself is not the enemy; the way we use it matters most.
Biroq ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning o'zi dushman emas; eng muhimi, ulardan qanday foydalanishimiz.
Psychologists advise setting a daily time limit and turning off unnecessary notifications.
Psixologlar kunlik vaqt chegarasini belgilash va keraksiz bildirishnomalarni o'chirishni maslahat berishadi.
Using these apps to arrange real meetings, rather than to replace them, seems to be the healthiest approach.
Bu ilovalardan uchrashuvlarni almashtirish uchun emas, balki ularni tashkil qilish uchun foydalanish eng sog'lom yondashuvga o'xshaydi.

title: The Aral Sea
sentences: The Aral Sea was once the fourth largest lake in the world.
Orol dengizi bir paytlar dunyodagi to'rtinchi eng katta ko'l edi.
In the 1960s, the rivers that fed it were redirected for cotton irrigation.
1960-yillarda uni to'ldirib turgan daryolar paxta sug'orish uchun burib yuborildi.
As a result, the sea began to shrink at an alarming rate.
Natijada dengiz xavotirli tezlikda qisqara boshladi.
Fishing towns that had depended on it for centuries lost their main source of income.
Asrlar davomida unga tayangan baliqchilik shaharchalari asosiy daromad manbaini yo'qotdi.
Today, salt and dust from the dry seabed affect the health of people living nearby.
Bugun qurigan dengiz tubidan ko'tarilgan tuz va chang yaqin atrofda yashovchilar sog'lig'iga ta'sir qilmoqda.
Many experts consider it one of the worst environmental disasters of the twentieth century.
Ko'p mutaxassislar buni yigirmanchi asrning eng og'ir ekologik falokatlaridan biri deb hisoblashadi.
Nevertheless, there is some hope.
Shunga qaramay, biroz umid bor.
A dam built in Kazakhstan has helped to restore part of the northern sea, and fish have returned.
Qozog'istonda qurilgan to'g'on shimoliy dengizning bir qismini tiklashga yordam berdi va baliqlar qaytdi.
Millions of trees are also being planted on the former seabed to stop the dust storms.
Chang bo'ronlarini to'xtatish uchun sobiq dengiz tubiga millionlab daraxtlar ham ekilmoqda.

title: Preparing for a Job Interview
sentences: A job interview can be stressful, but good preparation makes a huge difference.
Ish suhbati asabiy bo'lishi mumkin, lekin yaxshi tayyorgarlik katta farq qiladi.
First, research the company thoroughly: its products, values and recent news.
Avval kompaniyani puxta o'rganing: mahsulotlari, qadriyatlari va so'nggi yangiliklarini.
Interviewers are often impressed when a candidate asks thoughtful questions about the role.
Nomzod lavozim haqida o'ylangan savollar bersa, suhbatdoshlar ko'pincha taassurot oladi.
Next, think about your strengths and support each one with a real example.
Keyin kuchli tomonlaringiz haqida o'ylang va har birini haqiqiy misol bilan tasdiqlang.
When you are asked about your weaknesses, be honest but explain how you are working on them.
Zaif tomonlaringiz haqida so'rashsa, halol bo'ling, lekin ular ustida qanday ishlayotganingizni tushuntiring.
Practising your answers out loud, ideally with a friend, will increase your confidence.
Javoblaringizni ovoz chiqarib, iloji bo'lsa do'stingiz bilan mashq qilish ishonchingizni oshiradi.
Remember that the first impression is formed within a few minutes.
Birinchi taassurot bir necha daqiqada shakllanishini unutmang.
Arrive on time, dress appropriately and don't forget to smile.
O'z vaqtida keling, munosib kiyining va jilmayishni unutmang.
